limited_hint: Mail has no accounts configured on this Mac. Add an account in Mail, or use the mail provider's web app with browse_navigate.
probe: set acctCount to count of accounts
if acctCount is 0 then return "limited|no mail accounts configured"

actions.description: Newest messages in the unified inbox: subject, sender, received time, read state.
script: set msgCount to count of messages of inbox
if n > msgCount then set n to msgCount
repeat with i from 1 to n
set m to message i of inbox
set subj to subject of m
set snd to sender of m
set t to ((date received of m) as «class isot» as string)
set wasRead to (read status of m) as string
set out to out & subj & fsep & snd & fsep & t & fsep & wasRead & rsep

actions.description: Number of unread messages in the unified inbox.
script: return (unread count of inbox) as string
